basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript, React, Node.js | APIs & Developer Tools
basics.summary: Software engineer with 4 years of experience building web products end to end with **TypeScript**, **React** and **Node.js**. Enjoys turning vague requirements into small, well-tested services, making slow pages fast, and writing the docs the next person needs. Comfortable across the stack, from **PostgreSQL** schemas to CI pipelines.

work.name: Example Corp
highlights: Led the rebuild of the customer dashboard in Next.js, cutting median page load from 3.1 s to 1.2 s.
Designed a REST API for partner integrations, with rate limiting, retries and versioned docs.
Added end-to-end tests to CI, catching regressions before release and halving hotfixes.

work.name: Sample Labs
highlights: Built internal tools in React that replaced three spreadsheets used by the support team.
Maintained a Node.js service processing 2 million events a day and cut its cloud cost by 30%.

projects.name: Tiny Queue
projects.description: An open-source job queue for Node.js with retries, scheduling and a small web UI.

projects.name: Budget Bot
projects.description: A chat bot that categorises card transactions and sends a weekly spending summary.
